items.label: AWB: status
items.description: Show the mode, the queue and the last decisions of AWB

items.label: AWB: explain
items.description: Show why AWB acted, or did not act, on this post

items.label: AWB: shadow report
items.description: Compare the decisions of AWB with the decisions of the legacy bot

mode.label: Mode
mode.helpText:
Off: AWB does nothing.
Dry run: AWB writes what it would do to its audit log and takes no action.
Enforce: AWB comments, locks and removes posts.

exceptAuthors.label: Exempt authors
exceptAuthors.helpText: Usernames that AWB never checks. Separate the names with commas. The match is exact.

flairRules.label: Flair rules
flairRules.helpText:
One rule on each line, as Flair: value.
The value is skip, or a list of horizontal, vertical and square, separated by commas.
A post with a flair that is not in the list gets no flair check.
flairRules.placeholder:
Desktop: horizontal
Mobile: vertical
Other: skip

resolutionMismatch.label: Check the size tags in the title
resolutionMismatch.helpText: Remove a post when its title has a size tag, such as [1920x1080], and an image has a different size.

resolutionBad.label: Check the minimum size
resolutionBad.helpText: Remove a post when an image is smaller than the minimum size of its orientation.

aspectRatio.label: Check the aspect ratio
aspectRatio.helpText: Remove a post when an image is too tall or too wide for its orientation.

aspectHorizontal.label: Aspect ratio limits of horizontal images
aspectHorizontal.helpText: A:B to C:D. A:B is the smallest allowed ratio of width to height, and C:D is the largest. Write none for no limit on one side, for example 16:10 to none.

aspectVertical.label: Aspect ratio limits of vertical images
aspectVertical.helpText: A:B to C:D, as for horizontal images, for example 9:21 to 10:16.

rateLimit.label: Limit the posts of each author
rateLimit.helpText: Remove a post when its author already made the allowed number of posts in the window.

rateLimitPosts.label: Posts allowed in the window
rateLimitPosts.helpText: The next post of the author is removed.

sourceComment.label: Require a source comment
sourceComment.helpText: Remove a post when its author did not write a top-level comment before the deadline.

sourceHours.label: Hours to write the source comment
